name: AquaClimber
desc: A limbed swimming and climbing multi-modal robot. The first to freestyle swim and transition to vertical climbing.

name: ET-Quad STARQ
desc: Swimming, climbing, and running quadruped designed for NASA's 2022 Big Idea Challenge and further developed for research.

name: SELQIE the Underwater Explorer
desc: SELQIE is designed to traverse multiple aquatic modes- walking underwater, swimming mid-fluid, and transitioning between locomotive modes.

name: RRSTARQ bioinspired surface swimmer
desc: A quadrupedal, revolute-revolute modification of previous robot, STARQ, mimics biology such as dogs when surface swimming.

name: Muli-modal C-shaped foot design
desc: A more in-depth look at the design and hardware development of the multi-modal limb design of STARQ.

name: Leg Locomotion in Fluid
desc: Nelder-Mead optimization was run in a simulated fluid bed to aid in tuning optimization of a five-bar leg running.

name: MiniBobCat Concept
desc: Prototype of a smaller scale quadruped before designing and developing STARQ.

name: PropBoB
desc: Prototype of a propellor assisted climbing BoB robot.

name: Mechatronics & Art
desc: Collaborative work with sculpture students to create an interactive engineer/art installment.

name: DAVEs - Dynamics And Vibrations Experimentation systems
desc: Hardware built for Systems and Vibration class's lab experimentation section.

name: Senior Design - Flax Fiber Composite for Sikorsky Aircraft
desc: An environmentally conscious, flax fiber based composite and characterized samples to evaluate probability of use on or in aircraft.
